source.data:
@ExcelActions
Feature: ExcelActions

This is only a Sample class to read data from excel. 
Improve the methods and use them.

@ReadDataFromExcel
Scenario: Read and Print Data from the excel sheet
	Given I read the data from excel sheet and print it

@WriteSingleLineOfDataToExcel
Scenario: Add single line of Data to the excel sheet without deleting existing data
	Given I read the data from excel sheet and print it
	Then I write a single line of data to the excel without deleting the existing data

@WriteMultipleLinesOfDataToExcel
Scenario: Add multiple lines of Data to the excel sheet without deleting existing data
	Given I read the data from excel sheet and print it
	Then I write multiple lines of data to the excel without deleting the existing data
